title: Fix bugs in a Go statistics module
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in statistics functions (Mean returns sum instead of average, Median sorts but returns wrong index, Variance uses wrong denominator).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in stats.go.

Bug 1 — Mean: returns sum instead of dividing by count.
  Fix: return sum / float64(len(data))

Bug 2 — Median: returns sorted[0] for odd-length slices instead of the middle element.
  Fix: return sorted[n/2]

Bug 3 — Variance: uses population variance (divide by n) instead of sample variance (divide by n-1).
  Fix: return sum / float64(len(data)-1)

Note: The Mean bug also affects Variance since Variance calls Mean internally.
Fix Mean first; then Variance just needs the denominator fix.

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Median returns sorted[n/2] for odd-length input
StdDev passes because it depends on fixed Variance
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
